title: Only 7% Pass This Oxford Entrance Exam
summary: Arguments, assumptions and precise deductions test whether your reasoning can survive every hidden trap.

landing.intro: Arguments, patterns and logic traps collide. Can you defend the right answer when every option looks plausible?

about.body:
This independent worldwide-English entertainment challenge uses five increasingly demanding sections to explore reasoning styles associated with university entrance puzzles. It does not reproduce a real Oxford admissions test and requires no university-specific knowledge.

Every question has one answer supported by the information shown. Work at your own pace: speed never affects the score, and the challenge becomes harder through additional reasoning rather than obscure facts.

Your final percentage is the share of 40 puzzles solved correctly. It describes this attempt only and is not an admissions prediction, academic qualification or aptitude assessment.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Use only the information supplied in each question.
Choose one answer per puzzle; correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.
Continue through all five sections, then reveal your entrance score and answer review.

about.disclaimer: Independent entertainment challenge. Not an official Oxford admissions test and not affiliated with any university.

profiles.title: The Tutorial Standout

profiles.title: The Shortlisted Thinker
profiles.copy: You handled a demanding mix of inference and analysis, with only a few traps resisting you.

profiles.title: The Careful Reasoner
profiles.copy: You uncovered many of the deeper rules and built a strong base for a sharper second attempt.

profiles.title: The Promising Applicant
profiles.copy: Several reasoning styles clicked, while the review shows where one extra check would help.

profiles.title: The Curious Challenger
profiles.copy: This attempt exposed some convincing traps, but every missed clue offers a useful route back in.

questions.question: ARCHIVE is to RECORDS as ANTHOLOGY is to…
Which number comes next?
All fellows attend tutorials. Nia is a fellow. What must follow?
A rule says only badge holders may enter. Omar has a badge. What can you conclude?
answers: The rule alone does not show whether Omar entered

questions.question: Which word is closest in meaning to CONCISE?
A book costs £24 after a 20% reduction. What was its original price?
A marker points northeast. After a 90° clockwise turn, where does it point?
Grades rose after optional tutorials began. Which fact most weakens the claim that tutorials caused the rise?
answers: The exam was also made substantially easier

questions.question: Which conclusion follows? No poets are careless editors. Some reviewers are poets.
answers: Some reviewers are not careless editors

questions.question: A survey records 70 tutorial users and 50 library users among 100 students. Both or neither were allowed. What is the exact overlap?
Which evidence best tests whether a new reading list improved essay quality?
answers: Students say the list looks modern
Compare essays using the old and new lists under similar marking conditions
Count the books on each list
Ask one tutor which list they prefer

questions.question: If an argument says a longer library day will increase attendance, which assumption does it need?
answers: Some students who cannot attend now would use the added hours

questions.question: Which example disproves the claim ‘Every prime number is odd’?
A seminar has 18 students. Two thirds submit early. How many submit early?
Which statement reports the data without adding a cause?
answers: Scores rose because the room was quieter
The new method made everyone improve

questions.question: BOOK is to READ as THEORY is to…
A is before B. C is after B. Which order must be correct?
What is the next difference in this pattern?
Exactly one statement is true. A says ‘B is true.’ B says ‘A and C are false.’ C says ‘B is false.’ Who is true?
A tutorial begins at 14:35 and lasts 1 hour 45 minutes. When does it finish?
Every submitted essay was marked. This essay was marked. What follows?
answers: Nothing proves that it was submitted

questions.question: Three books cost £42 equally. Two more are bought at the same price each. What is the total cost?
A marker starts in the top-left corner of a square. After a 180° rotation, where does it finish?
A claim is supported by one anonymous comment. What is the strongest criticism?
answers: One unverifiable source is weak evidence for a broad claim

questions.question: A study finds students who sleep more score higher. What can it establish by itself?
answers: Every student should sleep the same amount

questions.question: The average of 6, 10, 14 and x is 12. What is x?
Which question exposes missing information in ‘Most students prefer tutorials’?
answers: How many students were asked and how were they selected?

questions.question: A candidate must submit a form and a reference. Mei submitted a form only. What follows?
answers: Mei has not yet met the stated requirement

questions.question: ARGUMENT is to CONCLUSION as CALCULATION is to…
A 240-page book is read at 30 pages per day. After five days, how many pages remain?
A marker moves one place right, two left, three right. Starting at 4, where does it finish?
Which revision is most precise?
answers: The results were kind of better
The average rose by six points

questions.question: Every shortlisted candidate passed Logic. Some candidates who passed Logic were not shortlisted. Which statement must be true?
answers: Everyone who passed Logic was shortlisted
At least one Logic passer was not shortlisted

questions.question: A code adds 2, then doubles. Starting with 7, what result appears after both steps?
Three essays—History, Law and Music—are presented Monday to Wednesday. Law is after History. Music is not Wednesday. What is Monday?
A report says 80% of 50 respondents agreed. How many agreed, and what limitation remains?
answers: 40; the sample may not represent everyone

questions.question: A 90° clockwise turn is followed by a vertical reflection. Where does an upward arrow finish?
A library adds evening hours and visits rise. Which comparison best separates the hours effect from a seasonal rise?
answers: Compare with a similar library that kept its hours during the same period
Ask visitors if they like evenings

questions.question: A rule admits applicants with Logic ≥ 80 and Writing ≥ 70. Ava scores 84/68; Bo scores 79/90; Cy scores 82/74. Who qualifies?
A conclusion requires P and Q. The evidence establishes P but says nothing about Q. What is the sound verdict?
answers: The conclusion is not yet established
